facts.quote: Levis entered the 2026 training camp behind Ward and competing with recently signed free agent Mitchell Trubisky for a spot on the roster as the backup quarterback. On August 30, Levis was waived by the Titans as part of final roster cuts before the start of the 2026 season.
On December 10, the Las Vegas Raiders placed White on injured reserve, ending his season.

The Buffalo Bills selected Jones in the second round with the 37th overall pick in the 2017 NFL draft. On May 18, the Bills signed Jones to a four-year, $6.77 million contract with $3.84 million guaranteed and a signing bonus of $3.07 million.
